frozen_test_status.rule: Original 2,250 A.4 TEST cases are consumed and permanently frozen as benchmark history. All diagnostic and redesign decisions in Phase A.4B are conducted exclusively on TRAIN and VALIDATION splits.

spatial_near_miss.interpretation: In more than 28% of cases where target was present, the model selected an adjacent or corridor cluster within 5km of the ground truth, indicating strong regional orientation with fine-grained intra-district cluster ambiguity.

location_v5_failure_decomposition.primary_bottleneck_verdict: BOTH — Candidate generation limits achievable accuracy to 73.51% maximum, but ranker discriminative power is also insufficient (34.7% conditional Top-3) to clear the required 27% overall gate.

feature_dominance_audit.findings: Because cash-out outcomes in the synthetic dataset are strongly pulled by terminal and intermediary mule accounts (which mirror real-world cybercrime movement), the binary match indicator captures immense operational predictive power. However, its binary nature causes tree splits to heavily bias towards coarse district matching rather than learning fine-grained multi-hop corridor transitions.
feature_dominance_audit.recommended_action: MODIFY — Replace single coarse binary indicator with a richer continuous representation: candidate_account_support_count, distance_to_terminal_mule_km, and candidate_corridor_transition_score.

time_v4_failure_diagnosis.analysis: In the V5 historical dataset, cash-out delays span 12 to 500+ minutes with standard deviations between 35 and 100 minutes per fraud family (e.g. Investment Scams have P10=160 min, P90=421 min, Std=100 min). The 11.5-minute gate was calibrated under the old narrow-variance synthetic V2 pilot. Predicting individual cash-out timestamps with <11.5 min error on this wide-variance distribution is mathematically impossible without severe label leakage.
time_v4_failure_diagnosis.recommendation: KEEP_TIME_V3_ACTIVE_AND_DEFER_V5_TIME — Maintain production cashout-time-xgb-v3 as active baseline while focusing ML improvement exclusively on the location ranking challenger.
